# madlibs-gan-turbovec

> **Madlibs-GAN + TurboQuant paradigm memory.** Index all past paradigms so the GAN game can find similar past games for inspiration.

## Quick Start

```python
from madlibs_gan_turbovec import ParadigmMemoryIndex

mem = ParadigmMemoryIndex(dim=384, n_bits=4)

mem.add_paradigm(
    paradigm='story_arc',
    topic='a programmer who discovers the substrate',
    template={'protagonist': 'programmer', 'antagonist': 'substrate'},
    fills={'protagonist': 'Dr. Elara Voss', 'antagonist': 'The Substrate'},
)

results = mem.find_similar_paradigms('story_arc', 'a love story between two AIs', k=3)
```
